stem: Which sentence from the selection supports the argument that fabric choices can have lasting harmful effects?

options.label: A
options.text: Cotton comes from plants, for example. (paragraph 1)

options.label: B
options.text: That means that a lot of old T-shirts and sweatpants just sit in our landfills. (paragraph 2)

options.label: C
options.text: It is one of the fastest-growing living things on Earth. (paragraph 4)

options.label: D
options.text: The material is made from water, yeast, sugar, and spider DNA. (paragraph 5)
